title: How Many Bots Can I BEAT with 1 Pawn?
summary: Bot ladder: player (white) has only the king and one pawn vs full armies of chess.com bots of increasing Elo, until a bot can't be beaten. Strategy: push the pawn, promote to a queen, then mate. Zach (1): first game he captures the pawn (impossible to win), retry wins. Elsa (150): loss then win. Martin (250): several losses then a win after much finagling. Juan (400): win. Noel (550): repeated losses; challenge ends with 4 bots beaten ('as far as 500-plus Elo').
rules: Player white: king (e1) + a single pawn; bot black: full army.
Pawn file not stated explicitly (inferred e-pawn, standard e2).
Ladder of chess.com bots: Zach 1, Elsa 150, Martin 250, Juan 400, Noel 550.
Retries allowed on a loss; run ends when the player gives up on a bot.
win_condition: Checkmate each bot in turn; score = how many bots beaten. Video: beat Zach, Elsa, Martin, Juan; stuck at Noel (550).
